info: MASTER REFERENCE EXPANDED - File 01 - Basic Greetings & Introductions

words.pinyin: Nín néng zài shuō yíbiàn ma?

words.en: Would you mind if I ask a question?
words.pinyin: Nín jièyì wǒ wèn gè wèntí ma?

words.en: Could you tell me more about that?
words.pinyin: Nín néng duō gàosu wǒ yìxiē ma?

words.en: Do you happen to know the answer?
How does this compare to the other option?
words.zh: 这个跟另一个比怎么样？
words.pinyin: Zhège gēn lìng yí gè bǐ zěnmeyàng?
Wǒ huì bǎ yāoqǐnghán fā gěi nín
Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē gè diànhuà ma?
Zài wǒ kànlái, zhè hěn gōngpíng

words.zh: 我可以澄清一下那一点吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ chéngqīng yíxià nà yìdiǎn ma?

words.en: Thanks for the update, I'll get back to you soon.
words.zh: 谢谢更新，我会尽快回复您。
words.pinyin: Xièxiè gēngxīn, wǒ huì jǐnkuài huífù nín

words.en: Let's agree on the next steps together.
words.zh: 让我们一起商定下一步。
words.pinyin: Ràng wǒmen yìqǐ shāngdìng xià yí bù

words.en: Please keep me posted if anything changes.
words.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu biànhuà qǐng gàosu wǒ

words.en: Feel free to reach out anytime.
Could you share a quick summary afterward?
words.zh: 之后能分享一下摘要吗？
words.pinyin: Zhīhòu néng fēnxiǎng yíxià zhāiyào ma?
Wǒ men shāo hòu zài tǎo lùn zhè ge 。
Nǐ jīn tiān guò dé zěn me yàng ？
Nǐ shì zuò shén me gōng zuò de ？

words.en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
words.pinyin: Nǐ zhōu mò yǒu shén me jì huà ma ？
Nǐ jīng cháng lái zhè lǐ ma ？
Nǐ xǐ huan zhè yīn yuè ma ？
Nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge dì fāng ma ？
Wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guò ma ？
Wǒ xǐ huan nǐ de chèn shān 。
Wǒ xǐ huan nǐ de zhè shēn dǎ bàn 。
Zhè ge zuò wèi yǒu rén ma ？

words.en: It was great to meet you.
words.pinyin: Hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ 。

words.zh: 能给我你的电话号码吗？
words.pinyin: Néng gěi wǒ nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ ma ？
Néng jiā nǐ de I n s t a g r a m ma ？

words.en: We should do this again sometime.
words.pinyin: Wǒ men yào zhǎo shí jiān zài jù jù 。

words.en: Enjoy the rest of your evening.
words.pinyin: Zhù nǐ jīn wǎn guò dé yú kuài 。

words.en: Enjoy the rest of your day.
words.pinyin: Zhù nín jīntiān guò de yúkuài

words.zh: 你是和朋友一起来的吗？
words.pinyin: Nǐ shì hé péng yǒu yì qǐ lái de ma ？

words.zh: 那么，你也说说你的故事吧？
words.pinyin: Nà me ， nǐ yě shuō shuō nǐ de gù shì ba ？

words.en: What do you like to do for fun?
words.zh: 你平时喜欢做什么消遣？
words.pinyin: Nǐ píng shí xǐ huan zuò shén me xiāo qiǎn ？

words.en: Have you seen any good movies lately?
words.zh: 最近你看过什么好看的电影吗？
words.pinyin: Zuì jìn nǐ kàn guò shén me hǎo kàn de diàn yǐng ma ？
Nǐ shì zhè yí dài de rén ma ？

words.en: This is a cool place, isn't it?
words.zh: 这是个很棒的地方，不是吗？
words.pinyin: Zhè shì gè hěn bàng de dì fāng ， bú shì ma ？

words.en: What kind of music are you into?
words.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan shén me yàng de yīn yuè ？
Nǐ yǒu yǎng chǒng wù ma ？

words.en: It was a pleasure meeting you.
words.pinyin: Hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ 。

words.en: Let me introduce you to my friends.
words.zh: 让我把你介绍给我的朋友们。
words.pinyin: Ràng wǒ bǎ nǐ jiè shào gěi wǒ de péng yǒu men 。
Nǐ hé shuí yì qǐ lái de ？

words.en: Do you want to grab something to eat?
words.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù chī diǎn dōng xī ma ？

words.en: Where could we go to eat?
words.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ qù nǎ lǐ chī ？

words.en: Do you want to get a coffee?
words.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hē bēi kā fēi ma ？
Wǒ men yào xiū xi yí xià ma ？

words.en: Do you want to go for a walk?
words.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù sàn bù ma ？

words.en: How much time do you have?
words.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu duō shǎo shí jiān ？

words.en: When do you have to go?
words.pinyin: Nǐ shén me shí hòu dé zǒu ？
Wǒ shì lái zhè lǐ dù jià de 。
Wǒ gāng kāi shǐ xué zhè mén yǔ yán 。
Nǐ míng tiān yǒu kōng ma ？

words.en: Would you like to meet up tonight?
words.pinyin: Nǐ jīn wǎn xiǎng jiàn miàn ma ？

words.en: Would you like to meet up in the evening?
words.pinyin: Nǐ wǎn shàng xiǎng jiàn miàn ma ？
